messages:
maria (Marketing): Quick SEO playbook for next week's launch + webinar. Need: keyword-to-URL map, event+FAQ JSON-LD, internal link plan from resources, and redirect clean-up. Who owns what?

alex (SEO): Ill do the keyword map + suggested titles/meta. Priorities: 'low-latency LLM inference' and 'developer inference platform'. Will add intent tags.

ben (Content): Ill write the blog + 3 FAQ Qs for schema. Will make the blog the canonical asset and put a registration CTA near the top.

rachel (Growth Ops): Ill handle UTMs and HubSpot wiring. Proposed hidden fields: utm_source=website, utm_medium=blog, utm_campaign=webinar_jun2026. HubSpot list: "HS - Webinar Jun 2026". Slack notify to #sales-inbound.

josh (Dev): Ill add Event + FAQ JSON-LD and the redirect rules. Quick canonical decision?

alex (SEO): Canonical: blog (https://www.redwood.inference.com/blog/llm-low-latency-launch). Landing (/webinars/low-latency-2026) should rel=canonical -> blog.

maria (Marketing): Internal links: add contextual links from /resources, /docs/dedicated, and the two relevant case studies. Keep varied anchors, avoid all-exact-match.

alex (SEO): Ill supply an internal-link sheet with anchor suggestions and limits (no more than ~30% exact-match).

josh (Dev): Redirect sweep: two old event URLs need 301 -> new landing. Will add nginx rewrite rules and queue CDN purge. Example: rewrite ^/events/2024-low-latency$ https://www.redwood.inference.com/webinars/low-latency-2026 permanent;

ben (Content): Meta description variants ready. Ill post 3 options in the sheet.

josh (Dev): Ill add a small CI check (lighthouse/schema validator) on staging to block if structured data fails.

seo-bot: crawl-report: https://seo-report.internal/scan/1768889999 (flags: two archived event pages recommended for 301).

maria (Marketing): Owners recap: Alex = keywords + link map, Ben = blog + FAQs, Josh = schema + redirects + CI, Rachel = UTMs + HubSpot. I'll schedule a 24h preflight QA. Ping me for blockers. :thumbsup:
